lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A rectilinear grid of high-luminance circular clusters is visible posterior to the gill slits, organized into at least six discernible vertical columns; the most prominent central column contains five distinct local maxima with relatively uniform vertical spacing.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Prominent vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs, creating a structured grid-like anchor system across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: At least three parallel horizontal ridges are visible on the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp vertical pixel intensity gradient showing light on the dorsal edge and shadow on the ventral edge.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin displays a high-density distribution of smaller, high-luminance spots which are more closely packed and lack the rigid grid-like organization found on the lateral flank.
